contract.wasmoon_cache: New empty TemporaryDirectory per sample, removed immediately after sample.
contract.timing_instrumentation: Instant around Wasmtime Module::new, Store/Linker/instantiate_async, and Func::call_async; existing CLI phase timers for Wasmoon.
contract.wasmtime_compile_boundary: Module::new includes binary validation, compilation and code publication; input file read and Engine construction excluded.
contract.wasmoon_compile_boundary: compile_validated_module_to_jit; separate parsing, validation, artifact verification, cache writing and JIT loading/preparation phases.
contract.invocation_boundary: First asserted probe call after instantiation/start and compilation/loading; includes guest GC and runtime helpers.
contract.wasmtime_instantiation_boundary: Store::new, Linker::new and instantiate_async, including start.
contract.ready_to_invoke_scope: Wasmoon: sum all pre-invocation CLI phases; Wasmtime: engine setup + Module::new + instantiation. API excludes file read; CLI parsing phase includes read.
contract.background_load: Unrelated host activity was not stopped. All samples, including Wasmtime round 3 compile outlier, retained.

rejected_minimal_feature_control.reason: Minimal feature build lacked CLI concurrency support; artifact compatibility failed in both directions. Excluded from primary timings.

measurement_driver_source:
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, resource, statistics, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time

root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
moon = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
probe = root / 'cargo-target/release/phase-probe'
fixture = root / 'probe.wasm'
env = os.environ.copy()
for k in list(env):
    if k.startswith('WASMOON_') or k in ('VCODE_REGALLOC_VALIDATION', 'MOON_WORK', 'WASMTIME_LOG'):
        env.pop(k, None)
env['WASMTIME_LOG'] = 'error'
rows = []
for i in range(5):
    order = ['wasmoon', 'wasmtime-api', 'wasmtime-cli']
    if i % 2:
        order.reverse()
    for engine in order:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sample-', dir=root) as cache:
            current_env = env.copy()
            current_env['WASMOON_JIT_CACHE_DIR'] = cache
            metrics = pathlib.Path(cache) / 'metrics.json'
            if engine == 'wasmoon':
                cmd = [str(moon), 'run', '--invoke', 'probe', str(fixture)]
                current_env['WASMOON_RUN_METRICS_FILE'] = str(metrics)
            elif engine == 'wasmtime-api':
                cmd = [str(probe), str(fixture)]
            else:
                cmd = ['wasmtime', 'run', '-C', 'parallel-compilation=n', '-C', 'cache=n', '--invoke', 'probe', str(fixture)]
            before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
            t = time.perf_counter()
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, env=current_env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
            wall = time.perf_counter() - t
            after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
            assert proc.returncode == 0, (engine, proc.stderr)
            data = {'round': i, 'engine': engine, 'process_wall': wall, 'user_cpu': after.ru_utime-before.ru_utime, 'system_cpu': after.ru_stime-before.ru_stime, 'result': 1}
            if engine == 'wasmtime-api':
                phases = json.loads(proc.stdout)
                assert phases['result'] == 1
                data['phases'] = phases
            else:
                assert proc.stdout.strip() == '1', (engine, proc.stdout)
                if engine == 'wasmoon':
                    phases = json.loads(metrics.read_text())
                    data['raw_metrics'] = phases
                    data['phases'] = {k: int(v)/1e6 for k, v in phases['phases_us'].items()}
                    assert data['phases']['compile'] > 0.01
            rows.append(data)
            (root/'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2)+'\n')
            print(json.dumps(data), flush=True)
print('MEDIANS', json.dumps({engine: {'wall': statistics.median(r['process_wall'] for r in rows if r['engine']==engine)} for engine in ['wasmoon','wasmtime-api','wasmtime-cli']}), flush=True)
limitations: One pinned parse_double property, macOS ARM64, not a whole-corpus conclusion.
Different API compile phase boundaries are explicit; timer ratios are not equal compiler-work guarantees.
No production code changes, commit, push, merge or release.
